Pakistan appoints Munir to lead new joint military command

Pakistan announced a restructuring of its armed forces that creates a joint command overseeing the army, navy and air force. The reform merges the three services under a single officer, General Munir, who was appointed to head the new structure. Officials described the change as the biggest military command overhaul since 1976. The announcement was reported by both left-leaning and centrist Indian outlets. No further details on implementation timeline were provided.
